events.text: Root-caused invisible '+' walls + speed diff: compiled game (world_loader.zig) re-derived wall colliders from render boxes (no wall-join/door/half-height) and hardcoded its own player radius/speed/gravity, while the editor play view uses placedPieceColliders (+-join aware) + state.config.physics. Fix: bake authored colliders + player config into two new map lumps (COLLIDERS=14, PHYSICS_CONFIG=15); world_loader consumes them, instance-derived path is now the fallback. TS round-trip verified (3/3), Zig ast-check clean. Needs a rebuild to confirm in-game.

resolution: Root-caused two symptoms (invisible '+' walls and a faster player in the compiled no-V8 game) to ONE cause: world_loader.zig fed the shared Zig physics solver from a different source than the editor play view — it re-derived wall colliders by guessing from the rendered boxes (no wall-join at a '+', no door/half-height/ramp-trim) and hardcoded its own player radius/speed/gravity, while /test uses placedPieceColliders (+-join aware) plus state.config.physics. Fix bakes the authored colliders + player config into two new map lumps (COLLIDERS=14, PHYSICS_CONFIG=15): new encoder cart/hmsc-int/compile/worldColliders.ts, emitted by packageMap.ts; decoded onto constructor.Scene and consumed by world_loader.buildPhysicsColliders + runPlayerPhysics, with the old instance-derived path kept only as a fallback. Flat painted floors still derive walkable rects from non-piece instance rows (else fall-through); the --massive bake drops COLLIDERS to keep instance windowing. TS round-trip + +-wall bake verified 3/3 under v8cli, all three Zig files ast-check clean. NOT yet confirmed in-game: needs a full Zig rebuild AND a map re-Compile (old game files lack the lumps and silently fall back). Per-tile surface friction not yet baked (flat baseline); speed/radius/gravity/walls now match the editor. Nothing committed (--shas none).
